mark_breakdown.desc: Evaluate to $-13$ and conclude the point does not satisfy the function

subparts.solution:
When $x = 10$, $y = \frac{1}{2}(10)^2 - 6(10) - 3 = 50 - 60 - 3 = -13$.
$\therefore (10, -19)$ does not satisfy the function $y = \frac{1}{2}x^2 - 6x - 3$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: If the computed $y$-value does not match the given $y$-coordinate, the point does not satisfy the function.
step_by_step: Since $-13 \neq -19$, the point $(10, -19)$ is not on the curve.
